tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: All Vitro markets with status, expiry, caps, totals and price (from the Proof API).

tools.name: get_market
tools.description: One market in detail (Proof API) plus a live price and phase check from the chain.

tools.name: list_series
tools.description: Current and past series with settlement round, price and who settled.

tools.name: get_series_settlement
tools.description: How a series settled (round id, price, path, caller), or which settlement window applies now and when the next opens.

tools.name: get_position
tools.description: A wallet's position: indexed history from Proof plus live collateral, debt, residual, claimable and synth balance from the chain. Omit market for all markets.

tools.name: get_events
tools.description: Indexed events (mints, repays, withdrawals, liquidations, settlements, redemptions, ...), filterable and paginated.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: TVL, fees to the treasury, liquidations and per-market use of caps.

tools.name: get_health
tools.description: Proof indexer progress and lag versus the chain head.

tools.name: quote_position
tools.description: Fee, collateral ratio, liquidation price and headroom for depositing collateral and minting, with the contracts' exact math at the current oracle price. Warns when the price is stale or the market is closed. Read-only.

tools.name: explain_risk
tools.description: Plain-language risk for a position: distance to liquidation, weekend gaps, expiry, settlement rules, USDG pause and freeze risk. Pass owner for a real position, or collateral and debtTokens for a hypothetical one.

tools.name: prepare_create_position
tools.description: Open or add to a position: USDG approval (if needed) and create(collateral, tokens). Enforces the 11 USDG minimum for a new position, both caps and a fresh price. Returns UNSIGNED transaction data (to, data, value, gas) for the user's own wallet; simulated against the latest block first and refused

tools.name: prepare_deposit
tools.description: Add collateral to an existing position: approval (if needed) and deposit(amount). Checks both caps. Returns UNSIGNED transaction data (to, data, value, gas) for the user's own wallet; simulated against the latest block first and refused if it would revert. Never signs or sends.

tools.name: prepare_repay
tools.description: Burn synth from the wallet to reduce debt: repay(tokens). "all" repays the whole debt. Returns UNSIGNED transaction data (to, data, value, gas) for the user's own wallet; simulated against the latest block first and refused if it would revert. Never signs or sends.

tools.name: prepare_withdraw
tools.description: Withdraw collateral: withdraw(amount). "max" withdraws the most the minimum ratio and 10 USDG floor allow. Needs a fresh price when the position has debt. tools.description: Create a mandate account: a smart account that is itself a sponsor, so limits can bind a session key. Existing positions can't be moved into it. The owner can never change: there is no owner recovery. Unaudited. Refused while mandates aren't enabled on this server. Returns UNSIGNED transaction data

tools.description: Stop one session key, or all of them with all: true. Takes effect in the next transaction. Returns UNSIGNED transaction data for the owner's own wallet; simulated first and refused if it would revert. Never signs or sends.

tools.name: prepare_mandate_withdraw
tools.description: Send idle tokens from the account to its owner, the only address the contract can send them to. Collateral in a position is not idle. Returns UNSIGNED transaction data for the owner's own wallet; simulated first and refused if it would revert. Never signs or sends.
